answer: At dawn, each agent must run a fresh kernel drill inside a 90-second window, seeded by its last three answers so no solution can be shared or precomputed across identities. One real machine spends about $0.40 of compute per drill, but a farm of 100 fakes pays $40 every epoch plus 5,000 POA locked per identity. A random one-in-eight spot-check then demands a live repeat within ten minutes, and failures burn the bond and erase the chained karst passage receipts that take fourteen days to rebuild. Like a cave that floods at dawn, only the tunnels you carved yourself stay dry enough to walk.
